pages.speaker: alfa-laval
pages.title: MaxiLobe rotary lobe pumps
pages.text: Get more from every production run with the Alfa Laval MaxiLobe hygienic rotary lobe pumps. Engineered for higher efficiency, a broader operating range, and simplified maintenance, MaxiLobe helps reduce investment and operating costs while boosting yield. Reliable performance across varying process conditions supports more uptime, consistent product quality, and lower total cost of ownership across dairy, food, beverage, and home and personal care applications.

pages.speaker: alfa-laval
pages.title: Compabloc heat exchangers
pages.text: With over 30,000 units handling tough duties worldwide, Compabloc is the market champion when it comes to heat transfer. Its compact design has been engineered for superior reliability and performance, making it easy to both service and install. The Compabloc family is 3-5 times more efficient than traditional shell-and-tube solutions and secures safe operation of up to 60 bar.

pages.speaker: alfa-laval
pages.title: PureBallast 3
pages.text: Alfa Laval PureBallast 3 is an automated inline ballast water management system for biological disinfection of ballast water. Operating without chemicals, it combines initial filtration with UV treatment to remove organisms in accordance with stipulated limits. The technology offers unmatched ballast water treatment performance in any type of water: fresh, brackish or marine.

pages.speaker: distributor
pages.title: Element Engineers — LKH pumps
pages.text: Element Engineers & Consultants is an Authorized Alfa Laval Distributor in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, supplying Alfa Laval hygienic process equipment and pumps. The Alfa Laval LKH centrifugal pump is a premium hygienic pump designed for efficient transfer of process fluids while helping maintain product quality and process hygiene. The LKH range is for food and beverage, dairy, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and home and personal care.

pages.speaker: distributor
pages.title: AEL Heat Exchangers — plate heat exchangers
pages.text: AEL Heat Exchangers are an Authorised Alfa Laval Distributer, and we have the full range of Alfa Laval Plate Heat Exchangers. Alfa Laval was founded in 1883 and is now a leading global provider of first-rate products in the areas of heat transfer, separation and fluid handling. As partners, AEL and Alfa Laval aim to deliver high quality Plate Heat Exchangers, mainly in energy, the environment, food and HVAC.

pages.speaker: website
pages.title: Moody Direct — Alfa Laval pump parts
pages.text: We supply spare parts and components for Alfa Laval process pumps. Centrifugal pumps include the LKH Series, with LKH Evap, LKHex, LKHI, LKH Multistage, LKHP, LKH Prime and LKHSP, plus the MR Series and SolidC Series. Rotary lobe pumps include OptiLobe and SRU. The twin screw pump listed is the OS Twin Screw.
